features: STYLISH BOTTLE ORGANIZER – The iDesign Water Bottle Fridge Storage Container holds up to nine standard-sized water bottles; it’s the ideal kitchen organizer choice for storing water bottles, soda, beer and more in the refrigerator or pantry

RAISED FRONT EDGE WITH RIDGED BOTTOM – This plastic kitchen storage container features a raised front edge and sides to prevent bottles from rolling out; the textured base design prevents bottles from sliding around when in the organizer bins

VERSATILE DESIGN – Use the versatile water bottle and drink organizer for fridge to organize beverage bottles, or in the cabinet or pantry for canned goods pantry storage; simply place the plastic organizer bins on the shelf for an instant shelf organizer
BPA-FREE PLASTIC – Crafted from BPA-free plastic, this kitchen pantry organizer and fridge organizer stands up to everyday use; hand wash only

description: Upgrade your kitchen organization and storage with the iDesign Bottle Organizer. This fridge can organizer with water bottle storage holds up to nine standard-sized beverage bottles. It’s a versatile water bottle holder for refrigerator that can also be used to organize canned goods in the pantry or on cabinet shelves. Stack multiple bins or use them side-by-side to maximize storage and create the storage solution that works best for you. The can holder for refrigerators features a raised front edge and sides that prevent bottles from rolling or falling out, while the textured base design prevents bottles from sliding around in the bin. The transparent design of the clear plastic storage bins ensures items are always visible and accessible. Measuring 13.7" x 5.4" x 4.1", this bin is ideal for compact spaces in the refrigerator or pantry.
Made with durable BPA-free clear plastic, this pantry organization bin stands up to everyday use. With iDesign, you can live simply and sustainably every day.
